# Audio sub-actions

## Play sound

Plays one sound file on your computer, like an alert sound or a funny noise. It can wait until the sound is over or carry on straight away.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Sound file** | The sound's full location on your computer, like C:\Sounds\airhorn.mp3. Works with .wav, .mp3, .ogg and .flac files. |
| **Output device** | Which speakers or headphones to play on, picked from the list. Empty = your computer's normal sound output. |
| **Volume (0-100)** | How loud, from 0 (silent) to 100 (full). The default is 100. Starts as: `100`. |
| **Wait until finished** | Tick to wait until the sound is over before the next step. Unticked, the next step starts right away. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Sound tag** | Optional. A name you make up, so "Stop sounds" can stop all sounds with that name, like "alerts". |
| **Use the file name as the tag** | Tick to use the sound's file name (like "airhorn") as its tag, so "Stop sounds" can stop it by name. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%soundFile%` | The location of the sound that was played |
| `%soundDuration%` | How long the sound lasts, in seconds |
| `%soundDurationMs%` | How long the sound lasts, in milliseconds |

<small>Type id: `audio.playSound`</small>

## Play sound from folder

Plays one random sound from a folder on your computer. Add new files to the folder and they join in automatically. Great for a pile of different alert sounds.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Folder** | The folder's full location on your computer, like C:\Sounds\Alerts. |
| **File types** | Which kinds of files to use, separated by commas, like "wav, mp3". Empty = every kind Cuebot can play. Starts as: `wav, mp3, ogg, flac`. |
| **Include subfolders** | Tick to also pick sounds from folders inside this folder. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Output device** | Which speakers or headphones to play on, picked from the list. Empty = your computer's normal sound output. |
| **Volume (0-100)** | How loud, from 0 (silent) to 100 (full). The default is 100. Starts as: `100`. |
| **Wait until finished** | Tick to wait until the sound is over before the next step. Unticked, the next step starts right away. Starts as: `true`. |
| **Sound tag** | Optional. A name you make up, so "Stop sounds" can stop all sounds with that name, like "alerts". |
| **Use the file name as the tag** | Tick to use the picked sound's file name (like "airhorn") as its tag, so "Stop sounds" can stop it by name. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%randomSoundFile%` | The location of the sound that was picked |
| `%randomSoundFileName%` | The picked sound's file name, like airhorn.mp3 |
| `%soundDuration%` | How long the sound lasts, in seconds |

<small>Type id: `audio.playSoundFromFolder`</small>

## Stop sounds

Stops sounds that Cuebot is playing right now. Good as a "shut up" button when an alert goes on too long.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Sound tag** | Stop only sounds that have this tag. Empty = stop every sound. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%soundsStopped%` | How many sounds were stopped |

<small>Type id: `audio.stopSounds`</small>
